head_commit.message:
perf(core): preserve numeric memo when updates leave dictionary unchanged (#6486)

* perf(core): preserve numeric memo across unchanged dictionaries

Avoid invalidating the cached high-precision-decimal verdict when a delta
adds no stored dictionary terms. Document cache coherence and test dense,
sparse, forked and mapped mutation paths.
